conditions: Integers n and k satisfy 0 <= k <= n; distinct items, no replacement.
spoken_aliases: the number of permutations of n items taken k at a time equals n factorial divided by the factorial of the quantity n minus k
p of n comma k equals the fraction with numerator n factorial and denominator open parenthesis n minus k close parenthesis factorial

evidence: The first position has n choices, the second n-1, and the kth n-k+1. The multiplication principle gives their product, n!/(n-k)!. For k=0 the empty product is one, including n=0.
Reference cross-check: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/11-5-counting-principles. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
